title: KickBlong's Survival+
description: makes Minecraft more interesting and adds boats that work
body:
makes MineKickBlong’s Survival+ is a carefully curated Minecraft modpack designed to expand the vanilla survival experience without losing its familiar feel. Built for players who love exploration, progression, and quality-of-life improvements, this pack enhances every stage of the game while keeping gameplay balanced and rewarding.

The world feels larger and more alive thanks to expanded oceans, improved structures, and overhauled dungeons. Mods like YUNG’s structure series transform mineshafts, nether fortresses, and other locations into detailed, dangerous places worth exploring. Exploration is further rewarded with better loot systems and new challenges that encourage adventure beyond your base.

Survival mechanics are deepened through improved farming, food variety, and immersive progression systems. Quality-of-life additions such as better tooltips, inventory clarity, and map enhancements reduce frustration while keeping the experience immersive. The inclusion of dimension-based content and unique encounters adds long-term goals for dedicated players.

KickBlong’s Survival+ is ideal for solo players or small servers looking for a polished, long-lasting survival experience. It stays true to Minecraft’s core identity while adding enough depth, discovery, and challenge to keep each new world feeling fresh, exciting, and worth investing time into.craft more interesting and adds boats that work
